resources.string: Listening… let go when you\'re done
Nothing understood. Hold and try again.
Hold the button and speak. The text goes to the clipboard and Lapacho\'s keyboard offers it. Nothing leaves this phone.
Dictation needs its model, once: Parakeet, 25 languages, a 487 MB download. Tap Download model, wait for the browser to finish, then Import model and pick it in Download.
Importing… %1$d %%. A few minutes on a phone; the screen stays on until it is done.
Lapacho Voice needs the microphone to hear you. It records only while you hold the button.
Use the phone\'s recognizer instead (not sovereign: another app\'s, usually Google\'s, on this phone; nothing to download)
Hold the button and speak. The phone\'s recognizer turns it into text, on this phone, but it is another app\'s code (usually Google\'s), not Lapacho\'s.
the phone\'s recognizer failed (%1$d). It may need its language downloaded, in its own settings.
The phone\'s recognizer is downloading its language (its own download). Try again in a minute.
